questions.question: Whom does Psalm 146 warn not to put trust in?
options: Armies, in horses and chariots, which cannot save the king
Idols, in graven images, which have mouths but cannot speak
Riches, in great wealth, which take wings and fly away
Princes, in a son of man, in whom there is no salvation
questions.answer: Princes, in a son of man, in whom there is no salvation

questions.question: What does the LORD do for the oppressed and hungry, according to Psalm 146?
options: Reveals his law and his statutes
Subdues the nations and the kings
Sends the rain and the sunshine

questions.question: The psalm says the LORD lifts up those who are bowed down and loves the righteous.
Put not your trust in _____, in a son of man, in whom there is no salvation.
The LORD opens the eyes of the _____; the LORD lifts up those who are bowed down.
